exposure: maternal methadone dose at delivery (<30 mg/day vs >30 mg/day)
cohort: The study included methadone-maintained mother and infant pairs from an inner city Specialist NHS Substance Misuse Service.
finding: Infants of mothers receiving <30 mg/day methadone at delivery were nearly twice as likely to be treated for Neonatal Withdrawal Syndrome compared to those whose mothers received >30 mg/day.
